description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: sb-pcl::install-optimized-constructor -> pcl-compile -> compile-in-lexenv on the first (make-instance 'cl-ppcre::anchor ...) etc. (backtrace in the s541a session: cl-ppcre::convert-compound-parse-tree -> make-instance -> install-initial-constructor).  The saved core has not run them, so EVERY program pays them on its first regexes.

MEASURED: tools/board-timing.pl --run's new bucket rcompile (a native compile not requested by SBCL's top-level eval): 1.13 s over the board, 44 files above 5 ms, 8 dists.  scratch/s541a/micro/ppcre-first.lisp (the tree's core, quiet, x3): 40 patterns of many shapes, pass 1 4.0 ms / 6 native compiles, pass 2 (40 other patterns of the same shapes) 0.0 ms / 0; m-regexfirst.pl: 40 qr// built 7.2 ms (perl 10 us).

LEVER: at core build (tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm's core, before save-lisp-and-die) create scanners for a pattern set that instantiates every cl-ppcre node class (and touch the other CLOS make-instance sites the runtime has), so the optimized constructors are saved compiled.  Discriminating measurement: ppcre-first.lisp pass 1 on the new core: 0 compiles.  Size: small; core-build code only.
subject: PERF: SBCL compiles CLOS constructors / dispatch functions at RUN time -- the first make-instance of each cl-ppcre node class (a program's first regex of a shape) costs a native compile (~0.7-1.3 ms); 1.13 s over 44 board files / 8 dists; pre-pay it when the core is built
